integration.description: Odoo is an open-source suite of business apps, including eCommerce, sales, inventory and CRM, in a single integrated platform.
integration.overview:
The Odoo integration keeps ShopPrompter® in sync with your Odoo eCommerce: products and their variants (prices, stock, images, categories, translations), eCommerce categories, product documents, customers, orders and any content such as blog posts or pages.

It also embeds the ShopPrompter® chat in your Odoo website, including add-to-cart from the chat.
